title: Gas dynamics in an AGN-host galaxy at z ≃ 2.6: Regular rotation, noncircular motions, and mass models
question: What are the gas distribution, circular rotation, non-circular motions, and mass models (baryonic and dark matter contributions) in the radio-loud AGN-host galaxy PKS 0529-549 at z ≃ 2.6?

recipe.goal: Subtract Eastern synchrotron component to isolate dust continuum and generate [C I] (2-1) moment maps
recipe.method: Interactively mask only the Eastern synchrotron component in tclean (savemodel='modelcolumn'), subtract its clean components from the uv-data with uvsub, and re-image; construct [C I] (2-1) moment maps using 3DBarolo with a Smooth & Search mask
assumptions: Eastern continuum source is synchrotron emission from the radio lobe and central continuum is cold dust emission

recipe.goal: Measure and fit radial surface brightness profiles of dust and gas
recipe.method: Average surface brightness over elliptical annuli positioned at the kinematic center, inclination, and PA of the rotating disk (using synchrotron-subtracted Band 6 continuum for dust and an unmasked moment-0 map integrated over (-550, 550) km s^-1 for [C I](2-1)); fit 1D Sersic profiles using orthogonal distance regression
key_parameters: Annulus spacing = 0.10 arcsec (dust) and 0.09 arcsec (gas, half beam size); fitting range R <= 1 arcsec (dust) and R < 0.7 arcsec (gas)
assumptions: Elliptical geometry defined by kinematic center, inclination i = 53 deg, and PA = 75 deg

recipe.goal: Fit 3D tilted-ring kinematic model and apply asymmetric drift correction
recipe.method: Two-stage 3D tilted-ring fitting with 3DBarolo: (1) fix kinematic center on the minor axis and run 3DFIT to find median V_sys, PA, and i across 5 rings; (2) fix geometry, run SPACEPAR to explore V_rot-sigma_v space, adopt median sigma_v = 47 km s^-1, and rerun 3DFIT with WFUNC=2 for V_rot; compute asymmetric drift correction (ADC) for circular velocity V_c
key_parameters: 5 rings of width 0.09 arcsec; NORM=AZIM; LTYPE=3 (exponential vertical profile) with scale height z0 = 300 pc; V_rad = 0
Step 1: WFUNC=0, SIDE=B, initial PA=75 deg, initial i=50 deg, DELTAPA=15, DELTAINC=15, initial sigma_v=30 km s^-1, fixed center (5h30m25.447s, -54d54m23.165s)
Step 2: SPACEPAR grid V_rot in [200, 450] km s^-1 and sigma_v in [1, 200] km s^-1 with step 1 km s^-1, FUNC=2 (|M-D|), SIDE=A, R, B; final 3DFIT with fixed sigma_v = 47 km s^-1 and WFUNC=2
assumptions: Exponential vertical profile with constant scale height z0 = 300 pc; zero radial velocity (V_rad = 0); radially constant intrinsic velocity dispersion sigma_v = 47 km s^-1

recipe.goal: Identify and measure fluxes of non-circular kinematic components
recipe.method: Subtract best-fit 3DBarolo model cube from observed cube to create a residual moment-0 map; construct Renzograms integrated over (-191, -88) km s^-1 and (274, 377) km s^-1; extract PV diagram along a 0.225 arcsec wide path; sum pixels with S/N > 3 inside apertures in the residual moment-0 map
key_parameters: Velocity intervals: SW-tail (-191 to -88 km s^-1), E-tail (274 to 377 km s^-1), anomalous structure (-501 to -346 km s^-1); PV path width = 0.225 arcsec; pixel threshold S/N > 3
assumptions: 10% fiducial flux calibration uncertainty; same flux-to-mass conversion factor in the non-circular structures as in the rotating disk

recipe.goal: Fit dynamical mass models to the circular velocity curve and derive conversion factor constraints
recipe.method: Numerically solve Poisson's equation for the finite-thickness gas disk using vcdisk; model stars with a spherical Sersic profile (or exponential disk + De Vaucouleurs bulge) and DM with an NFW profile; sample posterior probability distributions of partial (gas-only, stars-only) and complete (baryons-only, baryons+DM) mass models using MCMC; compare dynamical masses with CO, [C I], and SED estimates (including preliminary 22-point CIGALE fits)
key_parameters: Normalization mass M0 = 10^11 M_sun; gas disk vertical scale height = 300 pc; Sersic gas profile n = 0.52, Re = 2.57 kpc
assumptions: Flat LambdaCDM cosmology with H0 = 67.4 km s^-1 Mpc^-1, Omega_m = 0.315, Omega_Lambda = 0.685 (1 arcsec = 8.22 kpc at z = 2.57)
Spherical Sersic stellar mass distribution (or exponential disk with Re = Re,dust plus n=4 bulge with Re = 0.1 Re,dust); NFW dark matter halo profile; CO line ratio r41 = 0.5

evidence.quote: The green band is centered at the median σ v = 47 km s
We find that (1) the molecular gas forms a rotation-supported disk with Vvrot/σv = 6 ± 3 and displays a flat rotation curve out to 3.3 kpc;
The gas disk of PKS 0529-549 is rotationally supported, having a median Vrot/σv = 6 ± 3.

evidence.quote: The non-circular motions are responsible for at least 12% of the total flux in the gas disk (2.8 ± 0.3 Jy km s−1).
This model gives a total stellar mass (bulge plus disk) of 8.0+3.5−7.8 × 1010 M⊙.
